title: Compact price-only: endpoint direction-loss ablation
question: Does an endpoint close-return sign penalty improve direction without worse whole-path MAE?
configuration: Canonical screened C1; 6,167 train / 2,302 validation; L35/H140 and matched seeds 0, 1, 2 on RTX 4060. Same Smooth L1 loss with or without a weight-1 sign penalty at close H35/H70/H140. Validation whole-path MAE selects both arms.
finding: Penalty raised path MAE from 82.626 to 82.674 bp and lowered H140 direction hit rate by 1.173 percentage points. Both effects had the same sign in every seed; H35/H70 direction barely changed. Keep Smooth L1 as the default.
limitations: Validation only, no text or test scoring; one loss form, weight, set of horizons and checkpoint selector; no paired uncertainty interval.

figure.alt: With the sign penalty, mean validation direction accuracy moved −0.043, +0.043 and −1.173 percentage points at H35, H70 and H140.
